defect: Recurring extra near-leg kick between two far-leg support stances. For example source32 far support ->34..38 near support ->39..41 near recovery ->42..46 near support again ->48 far support. A regular one-for-one alternating full cycle with a clean native seam was not established.
why_no_local_fix: Consecutive-frame selection cannot insert the missing opposite-leg support/swing. Shortening the clip around repeated near-leg stances would not supply a complete alternating cycle. No fake inbetweens, limb assembly, pose warping or ping-pong used.
input_change_outcome: Removing start_image did not resolve stance dominance. Start-image binding alone is therefore not an established root cause.
reusable_material: Both SW identity/camera/low-carry inputs, native videos, opposing support-pose samples and frame timestamps/review sheets. Not approved for runtime.
